result.reason: The operative language gives Corio a 30-day written-notice convenience right, requires a pro-rata refund of prepaid recurring fees attributable to the post-termination period, and bars Commerce One from terminating for convenience during any committed term, substantially reaching the preferred position. The existing term-end nonrenewal right does not conflict with that bar. However, allowing termination “in whole or in part” adds an unnecessary partial-termination right that could affect service and pricing economics beyond the playbook requirement. Drafting is otherwise clear and professional, though the refund language is narrower than an unqualified refund of all prepaid fees.
